title: The Serpent's Coil
motive_summary: Blackmail regarding a past crime (a botched theft years ago that led to severe financial and personal ruin for multiple characters).
overview_text: The air in the 'Priya's Flat' was thick with stale smoke and desperation. Nadia Cole lay sprawled near an overturned chair, dressed impeccably but violently undone. The cause of death was clear: a single, precise strike from a heavy 'Brass till weight'. It had been discovered by Elias Grant, whose initial gasp echoed off the muted walls. There were no signs of forced entry, only the unsettling orderliness suggesting the victim knew their killer or at least felt safe enough to let them in.
